# Agent assets (generated — do not edit)

Scaffolded into new dataset projects by `storywrangler new`. The canonical
skills live in `.claude/skills/` at the monorepo root; after editing them run:

    uv run python scripts/sync_agent_assets.py

`mcp.json` is authored here (it is the template for the generated project's
`.mcp.json`, not a synced copy).
